The data is the Palmer penguins data set, one row per penguin (repeated in each panel). Aesthetics: x = bill length, y = flipper length, color = species. The geometry is points, plus a text label for each species. It is faceted with facet_grid: the rows are the palette (red/green vs Okabe-Ito) and the columns are the vision type (typical vs simulated deuteranopia).
